stem: A bank wants both faster failover and read scale in an RDS design. The architect must separate high-availability and read-scaling mechanisms clearly. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Use one NAT gateway per VPC as the database failover control plane.
Use IAM Access Analyzer findings as the replication channel.
Use Multi-AZ for synchronous standby failover protection.
Use AWS Config snapshot history as a read-scaling target.
Use read replicas for asynchronous read traffic offload.

rationale: Multi-AZ deployment handles high availability with synchronous standby behavior, while read replicas handle asynchronous read scaling. NAT gateway topology addresses networking egress, not DB replication and failover semantics. Access Analyzer is a permissions analysis service. AWS Config snapshots track configuration state and are not query replicas.
